items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: This is Joe Suttler. In fact, this is the same unit. This is the same unit.

ctx.x: Yes, I know I got that from Mrs. Simeon.

And this is Ernest Smith. He just died here about three months ago. He was living in Cleveland. This is the same banjo player, Washington. This is the same pianist, the same drummer. This is Joe Suttler. In fact, this is the same unit. This is the same unit.
The same unit. The same unit.
